title: <provider>.<resource>.ensured v1
description: Mutation event emitted by an adapter after a successful ensure_<resource> call. Mandatory per INTEGRATION_CONTRACT §6.5: every ensure_* MUST emit this event so the mutation is auditable and other adapters can subscribe via the reactor framework. Payload mirrors the wire body POSTed to /api/v1/events; provider, resource, verb, resource_id and instance_id are denormalised into the payload so subscribers can route without parsing the event type.
